captions.detailed: A 3D-printable model of a standard poker chip, designed to be flat and circular. The top and bottom edges are finished with subtle chamfers, giving it a smooth, realistic hand-feel. The main faces are designed to accommodate custom embossed or debossed text and values.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric poker chip in OpenSCAD with adjustable Diameter and Thickness. The design must support dual-color printing by separating the main chip body and the text inscriptions, allowing custom text on the outer ring and a central numerical value.
captions.factory: The design uses three stacked cylinders to construct the chip body: a central cylinder and two slightly tapered cylinders at the top and bottom to form the chamfered edges. It integrates the external 'write.scad' library to generate circular text on the outer rim and flat centered text in the middle. Depending on the 'part' variable ('single' or 'dual'), it either subtracts the text from the chip body using a difference operation or isolates the text models to be printed in a contrasting color.
